title: Meetings: Interruptions & Opinions
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Ya sabes cómo interrumpir educadamente y pedir opiniones en una reunión.

parts.visual: Interrumpir con educación: 'Sorry to interrupt, but...' (Perdón por interrumpir, pero...). 'Can I add something here?' (¿Puedo agregar algo aquí?). 'Excuse me, could I say something?' (Disculpe, ¿podría decir algo?).
parts.audio: Polite interruptions. Sorry to interrupt, but... Can I add something here? Excuse me, could I say something?

parts.visual: Pedir opiniones: 'What do you think about this?' (¿Qué piensas sobre esto?). 'How do you feel about this idea?' (¿Qué opinas de esta idea?). 'Any thoughts on this?' (¿Alguna idea/opinión sobre esto?).
parts.audio: Asking for opinions. What do you think about this? How do you feel about this idea? Any thoughts on this?

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la palabra correcta para completar la frase de la reunión.

questions.question: Sorry to ____, but we have a problem. (Interrumpir).
questions.explanation: Sorry to interrupt = perdón por interrumpir.

questions.question: Can I ____ something here? (Agregar/Añadir).
questions.explanation: Can I add something here? = ¿Puedo agregar/añadir algo aquí?

questions.question: Excuse me, could I ____ something? (Decir).
questions.explanation: Could I say something? = ¿Podría decir algo?

questions.question: What do you ____ about the new budget? (Pensar/Opinar).
questions.explanation: What do you think about...? = ¿Qué opinas sobre...?

questions.question: How do you ____ about this strategy? (Opinar/Sentir).
questions.explanation: How do you feel about...? es otra forma común de pedir opinión.

questions.question: If I could just ____ in for a second... (Intervenir/Entrar).
questions.explanation: Jump in = intervenir en una conversación.

questions.question: Before we move ____, I'd like to say something. (Avanzar).
questions.explanation: Move on = pasar al siguiente tema/avanzar.

questions.question: I'd like to get your ____ on this. (Opinión/Perspectiva - Input).
questions.explanation: Get someone's input = recibir la opinión/perspectiva de alguien.

questions.question: Does anyone have anything to ____? (Añadir/Agregar).
questions.explanation: Have anything to add = tener algo que agregar.

questions.question: In my ____, this is a bad idea. (Opinión).
questions.explanation: In my opinion = En mi opinión.

questions.question: From my point of ____, we should wait. (Punto de vista).
questions.explanation: Point of view = punto de vista.

questions.question: I completely ____ with you. (Estoy de acuerdo).
questions.explanation: Agree es un verbo en inglés, no se usa con el verbo To Be. (I agree, NO I am agree).

questions.question: I'm afraid I ____ with that. (No estoy de acuerdo).
questions.explanation: I disagree = no estoy de acuerdo.

questions.question: That's a good ____. (Punto/Observación).
questions.explanation: That's a good point = es un buen punto / buena observación.

questions.question: Let's ____ back to the main topic. (Volver).
questions.explanation: Get back to = volver a (un tema).

questions.question: May I ____ a question? (Hacer una pregunta).
questions.explanation: Ask a question = hacer una pregunta.

questions.question: What's your ____ on this? (Postura/Opinión - Take).
questions.explanation: What's your take on this? = ¿Cuál es tu postura/opinión al respecto?

questions.question: Just to ____, you want us to delay the launch? (Aclarar).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe la palabra clave para cada frase de reunión.

questions.question: I'd like to get your ____. (Aporte/Opinión - input)
In my ____, it is too expensive. (Opinión)
I completely ____ with you. (Estoy de acuerdo)

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase exacta.
